contexts.text: Those who relate to the ventricles of the brain. Described. SE 830.
In the brain there are ventricles. Their use. SE 1239:end.
The heart is divided into two ventricles... the right one relates to the good of truth, and the left one to the truth of good... See also DLW 405. DLW 420. DLW 420:2.
The soul supposed to be in the three ventricles of the cerebrum.
